prior_open_findings.journey: Reopen the exact calculation used before a later refund or cost revision
prior_open_findings.expected: If historical calculation review is offered, earlier metrics and complete input lineage can be reconstructed; otherwise explicitly document that only current projections are supported.
prior_open_findings.actual: The supported authority overwrites one calculation row per scope/version. A later refund keeps the ID but changes metrics; the list is current projections, not immutable versions. Lineage lists event IDs but not the cost evidence used. This is a missing workflow, not a broken existing immutable-history contract. The final test validates the actual mutable contract.
prior_open_findings.business_impact: A seller cannot reconstruct the exact earlier profitability calculation from this projection alone, even though source events remain persisted.
prior_open_findings.suggested_fix: Define whether retained calculation versions are required; reuse canonical snapshot/audit patterns and include applicable cost/source identities. Do not relabel current projections as immutable history.

prior_open_findings.journey: Turn an advisory signal into an explicitly reviewed supported action
prior_open_findings.expected: Distinguish signal acknowledgement from a durable canonical HUMAN approval; do not claim approval or execution where only an advisory response exists.
prior_open_findings.actual: The request-action authority returns approval_required and says the recommendation is recorded, but it adds no durable approval/action record. There is no approve/reject/failed-execution/retry lifecycle in this authority. The default-deny external boundary is working and was not bypassed.
prior_open_findings.business_impact: A first-time seller may mistake a requested or acknowledged signal for a saved authorization or completed action.
prior_open_findings.suggested_fix: Clarify messaging and route only supported actions to their existing canonical HUMAN authorities; do not add a duplicate approval system or expose remote execution in QA.

prior_open_findings.journey: Create a first stock record from the inventory empty state
prior_open_findings.expected: An inventory empty state gives a supported UI path to create the canonical item before adjustments, reservations and channel mapping.
prior_open_findings.actual: The workspace tells the seller to create a product stock record, but exposes filters, adjustments, ledger and mapping only for existing items. Its canonical creation API exists; this suite seeds it through that API. Product master inventory fields are a separate model and are not a demonstrated replacement for this missing handoff.
prior_open_findings.business_impact: API fixtures can exercise populated inventory, but a first-time seller can still encounter a UI onboarding dead end.
reproduction_steps: Inspect the empty state and controls in unified-inventory.component.ts
Compare POST /api/v1/inventory/items with MarketplaceService UI callers.
prior_open_findings.suggested_fix: Plan an explicit canonical creation/handoff using the existing API, with opening balance provenance and HUMAN review. Do not duplicate stock ledgers.

prior_open_findings.journey: Read due-diligence, economic and financial evidence on mobile
prior_open_findings.expected: Every relevant visible caption and table cell can be evaluated without claiming obscured or incomplete contrast checks as passes.
prior_open_findings.actual: All 107 original repeated-state target occurrences were examined after real scrolling using axe. 101 passed and six caption occurrences remain incomplete; no contrast violation was confirmed. A separate financial-loss screen also retains four incomplete mobile nodes. These are manual-review tasks, not confirmed WCAG failures and not resolved findings.
prior_open_findings.business_impact: Automated testing cannot yet establish readability of every mobile caption/obscured table element; first-time seller comprehension and assistive-technology behavior still need review.
reproduction_steps: Inspect QA-P3-06 scrolling diagnostics and QA-P3-03 full-document axe findings on mobile.
prior_open_findings.suggested_fix: Manually review clipped captions and table reading/keyboard behavior, then authorize a focused responsive/accessibility correction if needed. Retain full-document axe checks and do not suppress incomplete results.

prior_open_findings.expected: A first-time seller understands what is known before the first run and the single next action.
prior_open_findings.actual: The reviewed synthetic planned-goal state displays a provider-mode-not-recorded warning, a DISABLED research-mode banner, journey research links, a separate confirm-context action and Start run. These describe different authorities, but their relationship may be unclear to a first-time seller. No blocked live-provider flow was executed.
reproduction_steps: Create a versioned plan without starting it
Review the journey header and goal card together
prior_open_findings.suggested_fix: Review pre-run wording and action hierarchy with a seller. Distinguish global configured mode from not-yet-recorded per-run mode; do not hide actual provider restrictions.
prior_open_findings.business_impact: Seller may misinterpret or be unable to complete the recorded operational workflow.
